001package org.clafer.domain;
002
003import gnu.trove.TIntCollection;
004import gnu.trove.set.TIntSet;
005import gnu.trove.set.hash.TIntHashSet;
006import java.util.Arrays;
007import java.util.Collection;
008import java.util.stream.IntStream;
009
010/**
011 *
012 * @author jimmy
013 */
014public class Domains {
015
016    public static final BoolDomain TrueDomain = BoolDomain.TrueDomain;
017    public static final BoolDomain FalseDomain = BoolDomain.FalseDomain;
018    public static final BoolDomain TrueFalseDomain = BoolDomain.TrueFalseDomain;
019    public static final Domain NegativeOneDomain = Domain.constantDomain(-1);
020    public static final Domain EmptyDomain = Domain.EmptyDomain;
021    public static final Domain ZeroDomain = BoolDomain.FalseDomain;
022    public static final Domain OneDomain = BoolDomain.TrueDomain;
023    public static final Domain ZeroOneDomain = BoolDomain.TrueFalseDomain;
024
025    public static BoolDomain domain(boolean value) {
026        return value ? TrueDomain : FalseDomain;
027    }
028
029    public static Domain constantDomain(int value) {
030        return boundDomain(value, value);
031    }
032
033    public static Domain fromToDomain(int from, int to) {
034        if (from == to) {
035            return EmptyDomain;
036        }
037        return boundDomain(from, to - 1);
038    }
039
040    public static Domain boundDomain(int low, int high) {
041        if (low == 0 && high == 0) {
042            return ZeroDomain;
043        }
044        if (low == 1 && high == 1) {
045            return OneDomain;
046        }
047        if (low == 0 && high == 1) {
048            return ZeroOneDomain;
049        }
050        return Domain.boundDomain(low, high);
051    }
052
053    public static Domain enumDomain(int... values) {
054        return enumDomain(new TIntHashSet(values));
055    }
056
057    public static Domain enumDomain(TIntCollection values) {
058        return enumDomain(new TIntHashSet(values));
059    }
060
061    public static Domain enumDomain(TIntSet values) {
062        switch (values.size()) {
063            case 0:
064                return EmptyDomain;
065            case 1:
066                int value = values.iterator().next();
067                return boundDomain(value, value);
068            default:
069                int[] array = values.toArray();
070                Arrays.sort(array);
071                // If the values are over a contiguous interval, then return a bound domain.
072                int low = array[0];
073                int high = array[array.length - 1];
074                if (high - low + 1 == array.length) {
075                    // A contigious interval.
076                    return boundDomain(low, high);
077                }
078                return Domain.enumDomain(array);
079        }
080    }
081
082    public static Domain enumDomain(IntStream values) {
083        Domain domain = Domain.enumDomain(values);
084        if (!domain.isEmpty()) {
085            if (domain.getHighBound() == 1) {
086                switch (domain.getLowBound()) {
087                    case 0:
088                        return ZeroOneDomain;
089                    case 1:
090                        return OneDomain;
091                }
092            } else if (domain.isConstant() && domain.getLowBound() == 0) {
093                return ZeroDomain;
094            }
095        }
096        return domain;
097    }
098
099    public static Domain[] enumDomains(TIntSet... values) {
100        Domain[] domains = new Domain[values.length];
101        for (int i = 0; i < domains.length; i++) {
102            domains[i] = enumDomain(values[i]);
103        }
104        return domains;
105    }
106
107    public static Domain union(Collection<Domain> domains) {
108        Domain union = EmptyDomain;
109        for (Domain domain : domains) {
110            union = union.union(domain);
111        }
112        return union;
113    }
114}
